propositions: fetcher._iter_pages terminates on a short page and advances by requested size instead of actual page length, causing 92% of issues to be silently lost from the inbound snapshot
Jira Data Center silently truncates maxResults when it exceeds jira.search.views.default.max, making a truncated first page read as the complete result
the defect causes collect() to build an incomplete inbound snapshot that passes reconciliation without raising errors while losing unbound issues and misidentifying bound issues as deleted
_iter_pages must advance by len(page) and terminate only on empty pages, with an offset-stall guard to prevent infinite loops when a server ignores startAt
the fix affects the shared core fetcher path used by both DC and Cloud adapters, requiring verification that existing cap, ceiling, and same-token-twice behaviors remain unchanged
